name: send-only-mac-messages
description: Send direct macOS Messages and transiently verify their delivery status.
long_description: A narrow local MCP server with one outbound tool. It accepts an exact phone number and message body, observes each exact outgoing attempt for up to ten seconds, and tries SMS/RCS at most once only after a definitive iMessage failure. It has no conversation, Contacts, chat, attachment, or later status lookup tools.

tools.name: tool_send_message
tools.description: Sends one direct message to an exact phone number through Messages.app, observes the exact iMessage attempt, and tries SMS/RCS exactly once only after a definitive failure. Returns a fixed status without echoing recipient or message content.
